Gap.description: A gap the layer's areas close in.

around.description: The areas around it by persistent id, the one sharing the longest boundary with it first.

InvalidGeometry.description: An object whose shape is not valid.

LayerFacts.description: One layer's facts. Places are `[x, y]` in the project's plane (m), as the objects' GeoJSON shapes give them.

area.description: Its areas' area summed, m²: holes out, arcs exact (not the tessellated GeoJSON's).

gaps.description: What the union of its areas closes in and none of them covers: a gap between parcels, an area's hole.

id.description: The layer's id, what its objects' `layerId` names.

invalid.description: Its objects whose shape is not valid, each problem once per ring (or line) at its first place.

length.description: Its lines' length summed, m, arcs exact.

name.description: Its name, as the layer tree shows it.

objects.description: Its objects counted by their geometry.

overlaps.description: The pairs of its areas that cover each other wider than the tolerance.

totals.description:
How many invalid geometries, overlaps and gaps it has in all: a list holds at most 10 000, the first in its
order.

ObjectCounts.description: A layer's objects by their geometry.

areas.description: Areas: polygons (with holes, of several parts), circles, whole ellipses, closed curves.

lines.description: Lines: lines, polylines (a closed one too), arcs, open curves.

other.description: The rest, not measured: texts, dimensions, blocks, hatches, architectural objects.

Overlap.description: Two areas of one layer covering each other.

a.description: The first area's persistent id: the smaller of the two.

area.description: The area both cover, m²: its pieces wider than the tolerance.

at.description: The centroid of its largest piece.

Totals.description: How many of each a layer has in all.

ValidityProblem.description:
What is wrong with a shape, as the geometry core's Geçerliliği denetle says it. An area's ring closes on itself by
construction; a ring that comes to nothing is `zeroArea`.

oneOf.description: Two vertices one after another at the same place (an edge of no length).
A ring whose area is nothing (its vertices on one line).
A ring that crosses, touches or runs back over itself.
A line that crosses, touches or runs back over itself.
A hole reaching out of its outer ring.

description: A drawing's facts, as an audit rule reads them (`facts.project`).

cut.description: Whether objects were left out: past the producer's limit, those after it by persistent id.

layers.description: The layers holding objects, in the layer tree's order.

tolerance.description:
The project's topology tolerance, m (its Topoloji settings): areas nearer than it touch, and a piece no wider
than it is neither an overlap nor a gap.
